entry.name: useKadunce
entry.label: Allow Tettegouche to open inside Kadunce's Spread when available

entry.name: offerRecent
entry.label: Show recent files and applications in Search before anything is typed

entry.name: recentApps
entry.label: Show the applications used lately on Search's first screen

entry.name: recentFiles
entry.label: Show the files used lately on Search's first screen

entry.name: offerNotes
entry.label: Show Notes in Search before anything is typed, when Gooseberry is installed

entry.name: showNotesPill
entry.label: Show the Notes pill on Search's first screen, while Notes is offered; notes still show among the results

entry.name: notesInResults
entry.label: List notes among what a search finds, while Notes is offered; the Notes pill still opens Notes

entry.name: showHelpersPill
entry.label: Show the Helpers pill on Search's first screen and a Helpers door on the dot's slide, while Split Rock's Core is installed; Helpers still show among the results

entry.name: showPeoplePill
entry.label: Show the People pill on Search's first screen, while a people provider is installed; off until it is turned on

entry.name: showFilesPill
entry.label: Show the Files mode on Search's first screen, while a file browser is installed; files still show among the results

entry.name: modeOrder
entry.label: The order of the modes along Search's top, as names joined by commas: apps, files, notes, people, helpers

entry.name: sectionOrder
entry.label: The order of the sections under Search's field, as names joined by commas: apps, files

entry.name: compactWhenFull
entry.label: When the sections on need more than Search's largest size, rest at Medium rather than at the largest size

entry.name: quickActions
entry.label: Offer quick actions in Search: typed words such as "remind me to call the bank at 3" name something Search offers to do

entry.name: quickActionsPlace
entry.label: Where a quick action shows: above, leading the results, where Enter does it; or among, as the first row of the results, where the best match keeps Enter

entry.name: quickSwitchesOpenPage
entry.label: A quick action for a switch, such as Bluetooth or Keep awake, opens the switch's settings page instead of changing it in Search

entry.name: quickReminderTime
entry.label: The time, as HH:mm, a reminder for a day named with no time is set for

entry.name: quickActionReminder
entry.label: Offer the reminder quick action

entry.name: quickActionNote
entry.label: Offer the note quick action

entry.name: quickActionKeepAwake
entry.label: Offer the Keep awake quick action

entry.name: quickActionDoNotDisturb
entry.label: Offer the Do not disturb quick action

entry.name: quickActionBluetooth
entry.label: Offer the Bluetooth quick action

entry.name: showAmbient
entry.label: Show Ambient's islands beside the launcher in the panel

entry.name: showQuickNote
entry.label: Show the quick note island beside the launcher, while Gooseberry is installed and the islands are shown

entry.name: showLayoutsIsland
entry.label: Show the Layouts island beside the launcher, while Split Rock keeps layouts and the islands are shown

entry.name: launcherPlacement
entry.label: Where the launcher's dot sits in the widget: start, before the islands; end, after them; or none, for a widget that shows islands alone

entry.name: ambientShows
entry.label: Which islands the widget shows: all, media alone, or others, every island but media

entry.name: ambientAlign
entry.label: Where the islands gather in the widget's width: center, start or end; unset, against the launcher's dot, the widget then as wide as its islands

entry.name: islandOutline
entry.label: Draw each island as a faint pill; off, the islands are words and glyphs on the panel alone

entry.name: islandSpacing
entry.label: Room between islands, in pixels, from 4 to 32; unset or 0, 8 between pills and 24 without an outline

entry.name: pearlLook
entry.label: How the launcher's dot is drawn: pearl, the Tette Dot; or magnifier, a magnifying-glass mark in its place

entry.name: animateIndicator
entry.label: Animate the panel indicator when Tettegouche opens
